COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 a.m. 17 June 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 18 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar and Galle to Pottuvil via Hambantota
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas off the coasts extending
from Kankasanthurai to Kalpitiya via
Mannar and Galle to Pottuvil via
Hambantota will be rough at times with
strong gusty winds up to (50-60) kmph.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be vigilant in this regard.
Naval and fishing communities are
requested to be attentive to future
forecasts issued by the Department of
Meteorology in this regard.
